name: Jansen Stead
summary: Defias bandits and mechanical Harvest Watchers roam the fields of Jansen Stead, just west of Elwynn.

sections.title: A Fallen Homestead
sections.body: Jansen Stead stands beside the road from Elwynn into Westfall. Once its farm fed the kingdom, but unrest has driven the family from the land. Now mechanical Harvest Watchers patrol the fields alongside brigands. The Watchers are tied to the Defias Brotherhood. Couriers and travelers between Goldshire and Sentinel Hill pass close by.

faq.answer: Jansen Stead is the first farmstead on the right after you cross the river bridge from Elwynn Forest into northeastern Westfall.

faq.q: Who lives at Jansen Stead right now?
faq.answer: The farm's original residents have been driven away. Hostile Harvest Watchers and footpads loyal to the Defias Brotherhood occupy its overgrown fields and derelict farmhouse.

faq.q: Why are mechanical scarecrows attacking people here?
faq.answer: Harvest Watchers are mechanical constructs that attack people in Westfall. They patrol the farm alongside Defias agents, though their exact origins remain uncertain.

faq.q: Who is nearby asking for help?
aliases: who gives quests near elwynn bridge
faq.answer: Farmer Furlbrow and his wife Verna are camped just south of the bridge near Jansen Stead's entrance. Forced from their pumpkin patch down the road, they have set up beside their broken wagon.

angles.text: As a human crossing from the relative peace of Northshire and Elwynn, you see the economic crisis and banditry gripping Stormwind's rural heartland at Jansen Stead.
Jansen Stead's fall shows Stormwind has failed to secure its borders. Defenseless homesteaders face outlaws within sight of Elwynn Forest.
